tile.retiredHint: Kept as they were; no new work order uses them

list.intro: The PPE garment labels: what each sewn-in label says, where every value comes from, and which revision work orders print.
list.exportNothing: Nothing to export in this view

empty.title: No labels yet
empty.body: Write the first PPE garment label: a style’s own, or one several styles share.
empty.bodyView: Labels are written by the compliance team; none exists yet.

noAccess.title: Labels are not for your role
noAccess.body: Reading labels needs the right to view certificates (compliance.certificates.view). Ask an administrator for a role that has it.

done.copyFailed: The code could not be copied: select it and copy it by hand.
done.activated: {code} r{revision} is active: garment labels print from it from now on.

done.retiredReleased_other: {code} r{revision} is retired: {count} released style revisions name it and can no longer release a work order until they name an active label.

new.title: New label
new.intro: Revision 1 starts as a draft: it may be incomplete; its record lists what to fix before it can be activated.
new.styleHint: Search by code or name; the label marks its standard and class.
new.styleNoRight: Finding styles needs the right to view styles (product.styles.view).
new.codeSharedHint: A shared label needs its code: 1 to 32 capital letters or digits, with . _ - inside.
new.fromHint: Another label’s content (another style’s, a company template), or the defaults.
new.fromDefaults: The defaults (the legal maker of the style, it + en, 50 × 80 mm)
new.after: Create opens the draft: the builder, its preview and its checks.

problem.invalid: It was refused as it is: check the code, the languages and the size.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not write labels for this company.
problem.failed: The label could not be created. Try again.

held.noManage: Your role may read labels, not change them (compliance.labels.manage).

held.printing: The test label is being printed

record.title: {code} r{revision}
record.changedDirty: Your unsaved changes are kept on this page until you reload.

record.frozenRetired: {code} r{revision} is retired: kept as it was. Start a new revision to use its content again.
record.viewOnly: You can view this draft, not change it.

action.sheetHint: The sample label at its size, to check on paper

problem.name: The label needs a name.

section.generalSub: Every text is printed in each language the label names (Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 art. 16; Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8(7)).
section.makerBrand: With a brand label the brand is the legal maker: its name and postal address (Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8(6)).
section.makerCompany: Our company is the legal maker: its name and postal address (Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8(6)).
section.compositionSub: Per part, the fibres add up to 100 % (Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 art. 9); computed from the BOM in a later wave.
section.careSub: ISO 3758: one symbol of each kind at most, in the standard’s order.
section.layoutSub: How the fields are placed and how big the label is; the preview says whether it fits.

field.languagesHint: ISO 639-1 codes (it, en, de…), at most 8.
field.makerAddressHint: Street and number, postal code, town, country.
field.importerHint: Only when the maker is outside the EU: name and address together (art. 10(3)).
field.noComposition: No composition yet: the label prints none.
field.animalOrigin: Contains non-textile parts of animal origin
field.animalOriginHint: Printed in every language of the label (Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 art. 12).
field.animalOriginOfficial: Left empty: the regulation’s own words (shown greyed).
field.animalOriginType: Type it: the regulation’s words in this language are not built in.
field.careTextHint: An optional care text per language; when one is given, every language needs it.
field.manufactureDateHint: Filled at print from the work order’s release day.
field.notifiedBody: Notified-body number after the CE mark
field.notifiedBodyHint: Category III: the body that checks production, four digits (art. 17(2)).
field.notifiedBodyNotCat3: Only category III carries one: remove it.
field.orderHint: Move a field with its arrows, or Alt + ↑ / ↓ on the focused row. The fields a PPE label always prints stay in the list.

optional.class: Print the class again in words

presetHint.STANDARD: Text 1.8 mm, CE mark 6 mm, pictogram 10 mm.
presetHint.COMPACT: Text 1.4 mm, CE mark 5 mm (its smallest), pictogram 8 mm.

care.iron-110-no-steam: Iron at up to 110 °C without steam
care.wetclean-w-very-mild: Professional wet cleaning (W), very mild process

preview.title: Preview
preview.local: Your unsaved changes, drawn on this page with the same rules the server uses. Save to keep them.
preview.server: The saved label for this garment, a sample: the batch or serial and the date fill in at print.
preview.cellDefault: Drawn for the style’s first colourway and its base size.
preview.marketHint: The languages a market needs (de, it): a missing one is named below.
preview.dateHint: Today by default; any day for a check ahead or back.
preview.failed: The preview could not be drawn
preview.noStyleTitle: No style to draw the label on
preview.needStyle: A shared label is previewed on a style that names it; no style revision names it yet.
preview.fit: Needs {needed} mm of {available} mm in height · {chars} characters a line
preview.fitUnknown: The size is not readable: the fit is not known.
preview.sources_other: Where each of the {count} values comes from

sheet.name: Label {code} r{revision}
sheet.standInsTitle: The CE mark, the pictogram and the care symbols are stand-ins
sheet.standInsBody: Drawn here as words in a dashed box: the real artwork (the CE mark’s official proportions, the EN 17092 pictogram, the licensed ISO 3758 symbols) is needed before printing on garments.
sheet.textSize: To scale, with the text drawn at 2.2 mm (the smallest the preview draws) where the printer prints it at 1.8 or 1.4 mm: what is cut off here may still fit. The fit line is the printer’s.

checks.title: Rule checks
checks.intro: What the activation checks on the saved label: an open line keeps it from active.
checks.introLocal: Checked on this page as you type; Save to check the saved label.
checks.introFrozen: Checked when it was activated; an active label is never edited.
checks.cellIntro: What a garment label of this colourway and size could not print with today: it does not stop the activation.

fixElsewhere.style: Fixed on the style (its standard and class).

passed.name: It has a name.
passed.maker: The maker’s name and postal address are there.
passed.importer: No importer needed, or name and address together.
passed.animalOrigin: The animal-origin phrase is there in every language, or not needed.
passed.care: The care symbols are known, one of each kind.
passed.notifiedBody: The CE mark carries a notified-body number only for category III.
passed.size: The size is right and the text fits.
passed.style: The style names its standard and class.
passed.bodyMeasures: The size has its body measures.
passed.batch: The batch or serial is given.

activate.title: Activate {code} r{revision}
activate.intro: Activating is the label’s approval: every rule check passes, and from now on garment labels print from this revision.
activate.frozen: Active labels are never edited: a change is revision {next}.
activate.workOrders: Work orders keep the revision they were released with.
activate.olderActive: An older revision stays active until you retire it: style revisions and work orders that name it keep it.

retire.title: Retire {code} r{revision}
retire.reach: No new work order is released with it.
retire.released_one: {count} released style revision names it ({styles}): it cannot release a work order until it names an active label.
retire.released_other: {count} released style revisions name it ({styles}): they cannot release a work order until they name an active label.
retire.noReleased: No released style revision names it.
retire.kept: Work orders already released keep it, and its prints stay on record.
retire.back: It is never deleted: a new revision can start from it.

revise.title: Start revision {revision} of {code}
revise.intro: A copy of revision {revision}, as a draft: revision {next}. Edit it, then activate it.
revise.keeps: This revision stays as it is; work orders keep the revision they were released with.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.intro: The form goes back to the saved label; what you typed is lost.

test.title: Print a test label: {code} r{revision}
test.intro: A sample on a label printer, marked TEST – not for garments; the job is kept with the label.
test.cell: The sample garment: {style}, {colourway}, size {size} (as the preview).
test.failedDetail: The printer did not take it.
test.noPrinterBody: An administrator adds one in Admin › Devices & printers.
test.printersFailed: The printers could not be read

versions.title: Revisions of this code
